name.description: Slug used as the default profile name. Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens/underscores.

display_name.description: Label shown in the wizard menu. Defaults to name if omitted.

base_url.description: Full base URL of the provider API, including /v1 if required.

default_model.description: Pre-fills the model prompt in the wizard. User can still override.

kind.description: Provider API format. Use openai_compat for most providers.

keyless.description: Set true for local providers that need no API key (e.g. a local Ollama instance).
